# Authored first-party staging only. Protected dependency and generated game
# directories are read-only. This composition builds, but does not yet enable,
# the local presentation domain; renderer capabilities are not fabricated.
if(PROJECT_NAME STREQUAL "DKRRuntimePreparation")
    if(NOT DKR_CAMERA_STAGE OR NOT EXISTS "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/camera-receipt.json")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Camera++ requires a verified fresh Patch Pipeline stage")
    endif()
    function(dkr_camera_overlay_targets directory)
        get_property(targets DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
        foreach(target IN LISTS targets)
            foreach(property SOURCES INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
                get_target_property(values ${target} ${property})
                if(NOT values OR values MATCHES "-NOTFOUND$")
                    continue()
                endif()
                set(replaced)
                foreach(value IN LISTS values)
                    set(next "${value}")
                    if(property STREQUAL "SOURCES" AND NOT IS_ABSOLUTE "${value}" AND NOT value MATCHES "^\\$<")
                        get_filename_component(next "${value}" ABSOLUTE BASE_DIR "${directory}")
                    endif()
                    string(REPLACE "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp/src/" "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/" next "${next}")
                    string(REPLACE "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp/tests/replay_probe/" "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/tests/replay_probe/" next "${next}")
                    if(next STREQUAL "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp/tests/replay_probe")
                        set(next "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/tests/replay_probe")
                    endif()
                    if(next STREQUAL "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp/src")
                        set(next "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src")
                    endif()
                    if(property STREQUAL "SOURCES" AND NOT next STREQUAL value AND next MATCHES "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/(src|tests)/")
                        if(NOT EXISTS "${next}")
                            message(FATAL_ERROR "Camera++ stage is missing ${next}")
                        endif()
                        foreach(source_property COMPILE_OPTIONS COMPILE_DEFINITIONS INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES SKIP_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS LANGUAGE SKIP_UNITY_BUILD_INCLUSION)
                            get_property(is_set SOURCE "${value}" DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY ${source_property} SET)
                            if(is_set)
                                get_property(setting SOURCE "${value}" DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY ${source_property})
                                set_property(SOURCE "${next}" DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY ${source_property} "${setting}")
                            endif()
                        endforeach()
                    endif()
                    list(APPEND replaced "${next}")
                endforeach()
                set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY ${property} "${replaced}")
            endforeach()
        endforeach()
        get_property(children DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY SUBDIRECTORIES)
        foreach(child IN LISTS children)
            if(child MATCHES "^${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp(/|$)")
                dkr_camera_overlay_targets("${child}")
            endif()
        endforeach()
    endfunction()
    function(dkr_apply_camera_overlay)
        find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
        execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/release-prep/v1.0.7/capsule.py" verify --output "${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}" RESULT_VARIABLE result)
        if(NOT result EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Camera++ source composition failed inspection")
        endif()
        dkr_camera_overlay_targets("${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp")
        get_target_property(renderer_support rt64 INTERFACE_SOURCES)
        if(renderer_support AND NOT renderer_support MATCHES "-NOTFOUND$")
            string(REPLACE "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp/src/" "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/"
                renderer_support "${renderer_support}")
            set_property(TARGET rt64 PROPERTY INTERFACE_SOURCES "${renderer_support}")
        endif()
        add_library(DKRCameraPresentation STATIC
            "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game/camera_presentation.cpp"
            "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game/camera_scene.cpp"
            "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game/camera_snapshot.cpp"
            "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game/camera_settings.cpp"
            "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game/camera_actions.cpp"
            "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game/camera_session.cpp"
            "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game/camera_runtime.cpp"
            "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game/camera_rt64.cpp")
        target_compile_features(DKRCameraPresentation PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
        target_include_directories(DKRCameraPresentation PUBLIC "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/include"
            "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game")
        target_include_directories(DKRCameraPresentation PRIVATE "${DKR_DEPENDENCIES_DIR}/rt64/src/contrib")
        target_link_libraries(DKRCameraPresentation PUBLIC DKRCustomMagicCodes)
        if(MSVC)
            target_compile_options(DKRCameraPresentation PRIVATE /fp:strict /W4)
        else()
            target_compile_options(DKRCameraPresentation PRIVATE -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math -Wall -Wextra)
        endif()
        target_link_libraries(DKRPortGame PRIVATE DKRCameraPresentation)
        include("${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}/overlays/camera-plus/SceneKernel.cmake")
        dkr_camera_scene_kernel(DKRCameraSceneV77 "${DKR_CAMERA_KERNEL_V77}" 77)
        dkr_camera_scene_kernel(DKRCameraSceneV80 "${DKR_CAMERA_KERNEL_V80}" 80)
        target_link_libraries(DKRCameraPresentation PRIVATE DKRCameraSceneV77 DKRCameraSceneV80)
        message(STATUS "Camera++: private presentation provider, per-view scene compiler, local controls and editor enabled")
    endfunction()
    cmake_language(DEFER CALL dkr_apply_camera_overlay)
endif()
overlays.launcher-polish/NativeOverlay.cmake:
# Compose after Camera++, replacing only the three reviewed UI inputs in a
# fresh stage. Checked-out sources, dependencies and older outputs stay intact.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../camera-plus/NativeOverlay.cmake")
if(PROJECT_NAME STREQUAL "DKRRuntimePreparation")
    function(dkr_apply_launcher_polish)
        find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
        if(NOT DKR_LAUNCHER_UI_STAGE OR NOT EXISTS "${DKR_LAUNCHER_UI_STAGE}/launcher-ui-receipt.json")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Launcher cleanup requires a fresh verified Patch Pipeline stage")
        endif()
        execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/release-prep/v1.0.7/capsule.py" verify --output "${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}" RESULT_VARIABLE result)
        if(NOT result EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Launcher cleanup composition failed inspection")
        endif()
        get_target_property(sources DKRPortGame SOURCES)
        set(replaced)
        set(count 0)
        foreach(source IN LISTS sources)
            if(source STREQUAL "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game/runtime_ui.cpp")
                set(next "${DKR_LAUNCHER_UI_STAGE}/src/game/runtime_ui.cpp")
                foreach(property COMPILE_OPTIONS COMPILE_DEFINITIONS INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES SKIP_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS LANGUAGE SKIP_UNITY_BUILD_INCLUSION)
                    get_property(is_set SOURCE "${source}" DIRECTORY "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp" PROPERTY ${property} SET)
                    if(is_set)
                        get_property(value SOURCE "${source}" DIRECTORY "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp" PROPERTY ${property})
                        set_property(SOURCE "${next}" DIRECTORY "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp" PROPERTY ${property} "${value}")
                    endif()
                endforeach()
                math(EXPR count "${count}+1")
                list(APPEND replaced "${next}")
            else()
                list(APPEND replaced "${source}")
            endif()
        endforeach()
        if(NOT count EQUAL 1)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Expected exactly one staged launcher translation unit")
        endif()
        set_property(TARGET DKRPortGame PROPERTY SOURCES "${replaced}")
        message(STATUS "Launcher cleanup: Save/Help disclosures removed; support actions precede final credits")
    endfunction()
    cmake_language(DEFER CALL dkr_apply_launcher_polish)
endif()
overlays.camera-shadow/NativeOverlay.cmake:
# Layer the shadow fix over the already packaged Camera++/launcher pipelines.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../launcher-polish/NativeOverlay.cmake")
if(PROJECT_NAME STREQUAL "DKRRuntimePreparation")
    function(dkr_apply_camera_shadow_fix)
        find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
        execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/release-prep/v1.0.7/capsule.py" verify --output "${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}" RESULT_VARIABLE inspected)
        if(NOT inspected EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Camera shadow composition failed inspection")
        endif()
        foreach(target DKRPortGame DKRCameraPresentation rt64)
            foreach(property SOURCES INTERFACE_SOURCES)
                get_target_property(sources ${target} ${property})
                if(NOT sources OR sources MATCHES "-NOTFOUND$")
                    continue()
                endif()
                set(replaced)
                foreach(source IN LISTS sources)
                    set(next "${source}")
                    foreach(name camera_rt64.cpp f3ddkr_rt64.cpp rt64_renderer.cpp)
                        if(source STREQUAL "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/src/game/${name}")
                            set(next "${DKR_CAMERA_SHADOW_STAGE}/native/src/game/${name}")
                        endif()
                    endforeach()
                    if(NOT next STREQUAL source)
                        foreach(setting COMPILE_OPTIONS COMPILE_DEFINITIONS INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES SKIP_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS LANGUAGE SKIP_UNITY_BUILD_INCLUSION)
                            get_property(is_set SOURCE "${source}" DIRECTORY "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp" PROPERTY ${setting} SET)
                            if(is_set)
                                get_property(value SOURCE "${source}" DIRECTORY "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp" PROPERTY ${setting})
                                set_property(SOURCE "${next}" DIRECTORY "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp" PROPERTY ${setting} "${value}")
                            endif()
                        endforeach()
                    endif()
                    list(APPEND replaced "${next}")
                endforeach()
                set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY ${property} "${replaced}")
            endforeach()
        endforeach()
        target_include_directories(DKRCameraPresentation BEFORE PRIVATE "${DKR_CAMERA_SHADOW_STAGE}/native/src/game")
        foreach(revision 77 80)
            set(target "DKRCameraSceneV${revision}")
            get_target_property(sources ${target} SOURCES)
            set(replaced)
            foreach(source IN LISTS sources)
                if(source MATCHES "/camera_scene_hooks\\.c$")
                    list(APPEND replaced "${DKR_CAMERA_SHADOW_STAGE}/kernel-v${revision}/camera_scene_hooks.c")
                else()
                    list(APPEND replaced "${source}")
                endif()
            endforeach()
            list(APPEND replaced "${DKR_CAMERA_SHADOW_STAGE}/kernel-v${revision}/camera_shadow_kernel.c")
            set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY SOURCES "${replaced}")
            target_include_directories(${target} BEFORE PRIVATE "${DKR_CAMERA_SHADOW_STAGE}/native/src/game")
            target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE DKR_SHADOW_ENTRY=dkr_camera_v${revision}_shadow_draw)
        endforeach()
        # VERSION remains a protected baseline input. Stamp this new build's
        # advertised network release consistently through the build pipeline.
        get_target_property(definitions DKRPortGame COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
        string(REGEX REPLACE "DKR_NETWORK_RELEASE_VERSION=\"[^\"]*\""
            "DKR_NETWORK_RELEASE_VERSION=\"${DKR_RELEASE_VERSION}\"" definitions "${definitions}")
        set_property(TARGET DKRPortGame PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "${definitions}")
        message(STATUS "Camera++: private per-view canonical shadow interpolation enabled")
    endfunction()
    cmake_language(DEFER CALL dkr_apply_camera_shadow_fix)
endif()
overlays.sdk2/NativeOverlay.cmake:
# Add SDK 2 after all accepted Camera++/shadow/UI overlays. This is an authored
# Patch Pipeline entry point, not a modification to the checked-out project.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../camera-shadow/NativeOverlay.cmake")
if(PROJECT_NAME STREQUAL "DKRRuntimePreparation")
    # Optional content-verified reuse avoids recompiling every unchanged source
    # when a small SDK fix is composed into a NEW immutable stage. Both stages
    # are verified below. Changed sources still come only from the new stage.
    function(dkr_sdk2_stable_path input output)
        set(value "${input}")
        if(DKR_SDK2_REUSE_STAGE)
            string(REPLACE "${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/" "${DKR_SDK2_REUSE_STAGE}/" prior "${input}")
            if(NOT prior STREQUAL input AND EXISTS "${prior}")
                if(IS_DIRECTORY "${input}")
                    # All potentially quoted/included headers were checked
                    # byte-for-byte before any directory can be reused.
                    set(value "${prior}")
                elseif(EXISTS "${input}")
                    file(SHA256 "${input}" new_hash)
                    file(SHA256 "${prior}" prior_hash)
                    if(new_hash STREQUAL prior_hash)
                        set(value "${prior}")
                    endif()
                endif()
            endif()
        endif()
        set(${output} "${value}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    endfunction()
    function(dkr_sdk2_rebind directory)
        get_property(targets DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
        foreach(target IN LISTS targets)
            foreach(property SOURCES INTERFACE_SOURCES INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
                get_target_property(values ${target} ${property})
                if(NOT values OR values MATCHES "-NOTFOUND$")
                    continue()
                endif()
                set(replaced)
                foreach(source IN LISTS values)
                    set(next "${source}")
                    foreach(base "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}" "${DKR_LAUNCHER_UI_STAGE}" "${DKR_CAMERA_SHADOW_STAGE}/native" "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp")
                        foreach(folder src tests include)
                            string(REPLACE "${base}/${folder}/" "${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/native/${folder}/" next "${next}")
                            if(next STREQUAL "${base}/${folder}")
                                set(next "${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/native/${folder}")
                            endif()
                        endforeach()
                    endforeach()
                    if((property STREQUAL "SOURCES" OR property STREQUAL "INTERFACE_SOURCES") AND IS_ABSOLUTE "${next}" AND NOT EXISTS "${next}")
                        set(next "${source}")
                    endif()
                    dkr_sdk2_stable_path("${next}" next)
                    if(NOT next STREQUAL source AND (property STREQUAL "SOURCES" OR property STREQUAL "INTERFACE_SOURCES"))
                        foreach(setting COMPILE_OPTIONS COMPILE_DEFINITIONS INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES SKIP_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS LANGUAGE SKIP_UNITY_BUILD_INCLUSION)
                            get_property(is_set SOURCE "${source}" DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY ${setting} SET)
                            if(is_set)
                                get_property(value SOURCE "${source}" DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY ${setting})
                                string(REPLACE "${DKR_CAMERA_STAGE}/" "${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/native/" value "${value}")
                                set_property(SOURCE "${next}" DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY ${setting} "${value}")
                            endif()
                        endforeach()
                    endif()
                    list(APPEND replaced "${next}")
                endforeach()
                list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES replaced)
                set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY ${property} "${replaced}")
            endforeach()
        endforeach()
        get_property(children DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY SUBDIRECTORIES)
        foreach(child IN LISTS children)
            # Renderer targets defined in an external build directory expose
            # first-party support through INTERFACE_SOURCES. Rebind those too;
            # dependency source paths themselves never match our stage roots.
            dkr_sdk2_rebind("${child}")
        endforeach()
    endfunction()
    function(dkr_apply_sdk2)
        find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
        execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/release-prep/v1.0.7/capsule.py" verify --output "${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}" RESULT_VARIABLE status)
        if(NOT status EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK 2 Patch Pipeline payload failed inspection")
        endif()
        if(DKR_SDK2_REUSE_STAGE)
            execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/release-prep/v1.0.7/capsule.py" verify --output "${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}" RESULT_VARIABLE reuse_status)
            if(NOT reuse_status EQUAL 0)
                message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK 2 stable-path source reuse failed inspection")
            endif()
        endif()
        dkr_sdk2_rebind("${DKRPORT_ROOT}/runtime-recomp")
        dkr_sdk2_stable_path("${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/native/src/game/mods/sdk2_bridge.cpp" sdk2_bridge)
        dkr_sdk2_stable_path("${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/native/include" sdk2_include)
        target_sources(DKRCustomMagicCodes PRIVATE "${sdk2_bridge}")
        target_include_directories(DKRCustomMagicCodes PUBLIC "${sdk2_include}")
        if(MSVC)
            target_compile_options(DKRCustomMagicCodes PRIVATE /fp:strict)
            # The generic schema/workspace renderer adds template sections to
            # the existing large launcher TU. Use extended COFF, not a smaller
            # editor or a different runtime ABI, on the Windows compiler.
            target_compile_options(DKRPortGame PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/bigobj>)
        else()
            target_compile_options(DKRCustomMagicCodes PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
        endif()
        # The original contract hashes the checked-out native closure. Include
        # this staged closure too. Hash content, not compiler/absolute paths,
        # so matching Windows/Linux/ARM peers retain the same 64-digit ID.
        file(READ "${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/sdk2-engine-identity.txt" sdk2_identity)
        string(STRIP "${sdk2_identity}" sdk2_identity)
        string(LENGTH "${sdk2_identity}" sdk2_identity_length)
        if(NOT sdk2_identity_length EQUAL 64 OR NOT sdk2_identity MATCHES "^[0-9a-f]+$")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "SDK 2 engine identity is invalid")
        endif()
        if(TARGET DKRExperimentalOwnedRegistry)
            get_target_property(definitions DKRExperimentalOwnedRegistry COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
            set(updated)
            foreach(definition IN LISTS definitions)
                if(definition MATCHES "^DKR_OWNED_BUILD_ID_V(77|80)=\"([^\"]*)\"$")
                    set(revision "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
                    string(SHA256 identity "${CMAKE_MATCH_2}|sdk2:${sdk2_identity}")
                    list(APPEND updated "DKR_OWNED_BUILD_ID_V${revision}=\"${identity}\"")
                else()
                    list(APPEND updated "${definition}")
                endif()
            endforeach()
            set_property(TARGET DKRExperimentalOwnedRegistry PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "${updated}")
        endif()
        message(STATUS "SDK 2: additive API admission and deterministic typed entity adapters")
    endfunction()
    cmake_language(DEFER CALL dkr_apply_sdk2)
endif()
overlays.mod-store/NativeOverlay.cmake:
# Add launcher-only Mod Store services after the accepted SDK/Camera++ payload.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../sdk2/NativeOverlay.cmake")
if(PROJECT_NAME STREQUAL "DKRRuntimePreparation")
    function(dkr_apply_mod_store)
        execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/release-prep/v1.0.7/capsule.py" verify --output "${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}" RESULT_VARIABLE status)
        if(NOT status EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Mod Store Patch Pipeline receipt failed")
        endif()
        get_target_property(sources DKRPortGame SOURCES)
        set(replaced)
        foreach(source IN LISTS sources)
            if(source MATCHES "/src/game/runtime_ui\\.cpp$")
                set(source "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/runtime_ui.cpp")
            elseif(source MATCHES "/src/game/runtime_texture_packs\\.cpp$")
                set(source "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/runtime_texture_packs.cpp")
            elseif(source MATCHES "/src/game/runtime_rice_texture_import\\.cpp$")
                set(source "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/runtime_rice_texture_import.cpp")
            endif()
            list(APPEND replaced "${source}")
        endforeach()
        set_property(TARGET DKRPortGame PROPERTY SOURCES "${replaced}")
        target_sources(DKRPortGame PRIVATE "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/mod_store.cpp"
            "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/mod_store_names.cpp"
            "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/mod_store_install.cpp")
        dkr_sdk2_stable_path("${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/native/src/game" store_game_include)
        set_property(SOURCE "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/runtime_ui.cpp"
            "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/mod_store.cpp" APPEND PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
            "${store_game_include}")
        set_property(SOURCE "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/mod_store_names.cpp"
            "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/mod_store_install.cpp"
            "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/runtime_texture_packs.cpp"
            "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/runtime_rice_texture_import.cpp" APPEND PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
            "${store_game_include}")
        foreach(target DKRCustomTracksCore DKRCustomTracksWorkerCore)
            if(TARGET ${target})
                get_target_property(track_sources ${target} SOURCES)
                set(track_replaced)
                foreach(source IN LISTS track_sources)
                    if(source MATCHES "/custom_tracks\\.cpp$")
                        set(source "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/custom_tracks.cpp")
                    endif()
                    list(APPEND track_replaced "${source}")
                endforeach()
                set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY SOURCES "${track_replaced}")
            endif()
        endforeach()
        set_property(SOURCE "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game/custom_tracks.cpp" APPEND PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${store_game_include}")
        if(WIN32)
            target_link_libraries(DKRPortGame PRIVATE winhttp crypt32 bcrypt)
        elseif(NOT ANDROID AND NOT APPLE)
            find_package(CURL REQUIRED)
            target_link_libraries(DKRPortGame PRIVATE CURL::libcurl)
        endif()
        message(STATUS "Mod Store: native catalogue, two saved layouts, background jobs and shared portal API")
    endfunction()
    cmake_language(DEFER CALL dkr_apply_mod_store)
endif()
overlays.shared-saves/NativeOverlay.cmake:
# Additive, receipt-checked first-party overlay. No dependency/generated edits.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../mod-store/NativeOverlay.cmake")
if(PROJECT_NAME STREQUAL "DKRRuntimePreparation")
    function(dkr_apply_shared_saves)
        execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/release-prep/v1.0.7/capsule.py" verify --output "${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}" RESULT_VARIABLE status)
        if(NOT status EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Shared save Patch Pipeline receipt failed")
        endif()
        set(shared_includes "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}")
        if(DKR_SHARED_SAVES_REUSE_STAGE)
            execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/release-prep/v1.0.7/capsule.py" verify --output "${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}" RESULT_VARIABLE reused)
            if(NOT reused EQUAL 0)
                message(FATAL_ERROR "Shared-save header reuse receipt failed")
            endif()
            file(GLOB_RECURSE headers RELATIVE "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}" "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/*.hpp")
            foreach(header IN LISTS headers)
                file(SHA256 "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/${header}" current)
                file(SHA256 "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_REUSE_STAGE}/${header}" prior)
                if(NOT current STREQUAL prior)
                    message(FATAL_ERROR "Shared-save public headers changed; omit header reuse")
                endif()
            endforeach()
            set(shared_includes "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_REUSE_STAGE}")
        endif()
        set(reuse_sources FALSE)
        if(DKR_SHARED_SAVES_SOURCE_STAGE)
            execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/release-prep/v1.0.7/capsule.py" verify --output "${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}" RESULT_VARIABLE source_status)
            if(NOT source_status EQUAL 0)
                message(FATAL_ERROR "Shared-save source reuse receipt failed")
            endif()
            set(reuse_sources TRUE)
            file(GLOB_RECURSE includes RELATIVE "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}" "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/*.hpp" "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/*.inl")
            foreach(header IN LISTS includes)
                if(NOT EXISTS "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_SOURCE_STAGE}/${header}")
                    set(reuse_sources FALSE)
                    break()
                endif()
                file(SHA256 "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/${header}" current)
                file(SHA256 "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_SOURCE_STAGE}/${header}" prior)
                if(NOT current STREQUAL prior)
                    set(reuse_sources FALSE)
                    break()
                endif()
            endforeach()
        endif()
        foreach(target DKRPortGame DKRLegacyModLaunch DKRExperimentalOwnedGameV77 DKRExperimentalOwnedGameV80 DKRExperimentalOwnedRegistry)
            if(NOT TARGET ${target})
                continue()
            endif()
            get_target_property(sources ${target} SOURCES)
            set(replaced)
            foreach(source IN LISTS sources)
                string(REGEX REPLACE "^.*(/src/game/|/tests/replay_probe/)" "" name "${source}")
                if(source MATCHES "/src/game/" AND EXISTS "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/native/src/game/${name}")
                    set(source "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/native/src/game/${name}")
                elseif(source MATCHES "/tests/replay_probe/" AND EXISTS "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/native/tests/replay_probe/${name}")
                    set(source "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/native/tests/replay_probe/${name}")
                endif()
                if(reuse_sources AND source MATCHES "^${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/")
                    string(REPLACE "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/" "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_SOURCE_STAGE}/" prior "${source}")
                    if(EXISTS "${prior}")
                        file(SHA256 "${source}" current_hash)
                        file(SHA256 "${prior}" prior_hash)
                        if(current_hash STREQUAL prior_hash)
                            set(source "${prior}")
                        endif()
                    endif()
                endif()
                list(APPEND replaced "${source}")
            endforeach()
            set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY SOURCES "${replaced}")
            if(NOT target MATCHES "^DKRExperimentalOwnedGameV")
                target_include_directories(${target} BEFORE PRIVATE "${shared_includes}/native/src/game"
                    "${shared_includes}/native/tests/replay_probe")
            else()
                dkr_sdk2_stable_path("${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/native/tests/replay_probe" shared_probe)
                foreach(source IN LISTS replaced)
                    if(source MATCHES "/probe_driver\\.cpp$")
                        set_property(SOURCE "${source}" APPEND PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${shared_includes}/native/src/game" "${shared_probe}")
                    endif()
                endforeach()
            endif()
            if(target STREQUAL "DKRLegacyModLaunch")
                dkr_sdk2_stable_path("${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/native/src/game/mods" shared_mods)
                target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE "${shared_mods}")
            endif()
        endforeach()
        target_include_directories(DKRPortGame PRIVATE "${DKR_LIBDATACHANNEL_SOURCE}/deps/json/include")
        # New confirmation envelope is a cross-platform contract change. Hash
        # identical source bytes, never compiler flags or absolute stage paths.
        file(READ "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/engine-identity.txt" save_identity)
        string(STRIP "${save_identity}" save_identity)
        get_target_property(definitions DKRExperimentalOwnedRegistry COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
        set(updated)
        foreach(definition IN LISTS definitions)
            if(definition MATCHES "^DKR_OWNED_BUILD_ID_V(77|80)=\"([^\"]*)\"$")
                set(revision "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
                string(SHA256 identity "${CMAKE_MATCH_2}|shared-saves:${save_identity}")
                list(APPEND updated "DKR_OWNED_BUILD_ID_V${revision}=\"${identity}\"")
            else()
                list(APPEND updated "${definition}")
            endif()
        endforeach()
        set_property(TARGET DKRExperimentalOwnedRegistry PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "${updated}")
        # The UI comes from the Store overlay; quote-includes resolve this
        # stage's save page first, preserving every other Store implementation.
        dkr_sdk2_stable_path("${DKR_SDK2_STAGE}/native/src/game" shared_base)
        target_include_directories(DKRPortGame PRIVATE "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game" "${shared_base}")
        get_target_property(sources DKRPortGame SOURCES)
        foreach(source IN LISTS sources)
            if(source MATCHES "${DKR_SHARED_SAVES_STAGE}/")
                set_property(SOURCE "${source}" APPEND PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
                    "${DKR_MOD_STORE_STAGE}/native/src/game" "${shared_base}")
            endif()
        endforeach()
        message(STATUS "Shared saves: stable personal/online ownership, explicit recovery and checked completion")
    endfunction()
    cmake_language(DEFER CALL dkr_apply_shared_saves)
endif()

overlays.camera-plus/SceneKernel.cmake:
function(dkr_camera_scene_kernel target directory revision)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${directory}/manifest.json")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Generate a NEW draw-only Camera++ kernel for revision ${revision}")
    endif()
    find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -B "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/release-prep/v1.0.7/capsule.py" verify --output "${DKR_RELEASE_CAPSULE}" RESULT_VARIABLE inspected)
    if(NOT inspected EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Private Camera++ draw composition failed inspection")
    endif()
    add_library(${target} STATIC "${directory}/camera_scene_functions.c"
        "${directory}/camera_scene_hooks.c"
        "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/camera-plus/native/camera_kernel.c")
    target_include_directories(${target} BEFORE PRIVATE "${directory}"
        "${DKRPORT_ROOT}/patches/camera-plus/native")
    target_compile_features(${target} PRIVATE c_std_11)
    foreach(helper access step fault)
        target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE
            dkr_camera_${helper}=dkr_camera_v${revision}_${helper})
    endforeach()
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /fp:strict /FS /wd4244 /wd4267)
    else()
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fno-strict-aliasing -ffp-contract=off
            -fno-fast-math -frounding-math -Werror=implicit-function-declaration)
        target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE m)
    endif()
endfunction()

policy: Accepted first-party source bytes; prepared guest/draw inputs are hash-only external requirements. Checked-out dependencies/generated guest sources remain read-only.
